verdict.rationale: Make's help center has a dedicated error-handling page covering error handlers and how to use them in scenarios, which supports defining dedicated error-handling paths. Scenario history is also listed, which helps with reviewing past runs. Nothing in the pack shows alerts or notifications when a run fails, and the error-handler evidence is only a brief docs mention. Missing for 10: evidence of failure notifications or alerts, detail on error-handler route types or separate error workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
